_readme: Edit these values in GitHub if you want to change which rockets are tracked. The ntfy base topic is stored in the NTFY_TOPIC GitHub Actions secret, not in this public file.
_notification_topics_note: Notifications are split by launch location. If NTFY_TOPIC is CoolRockets, California alerts are sent to CoolRockets-CA and Florida alerts are sent to CoolRockets-FL. Each location topic receives 24-hour reminders, 3-hour reminders, new-launch alerts, and launch-time change/delay alerts.
_rocket_keywords_help: Only launches whose rocket name contains one of these words are tracked. Set this to [] to track every launch on the source schedule.
_notify_on_new_launch_added_help: If true, the matching California or Florida topic receives a one-time alert when a newly tracked launch first appears on the schedule.
_notify_on_time_change_help: If true, the matching California or Florida topic receives a new alert when a launch date/time changes or a previously unknown exact time becomes available. Reminder timing is then recalculated from the updated launch time.
